newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Lang sees good chance of success at telecom talks.
newsitem.headline: Lang sees good chance of success at telecom talks.

text.p: U.S. chief negotiator to the global telecom talks, Jeffrey Lang, said on Friday that he saw a good possibility of success in the negotiations.

"We have a good possibility of success," Lang said, emerging from the evening's session when asked what prospects for a deal were. He said he said he would have further talks with Washington overnight.
Referring to the U.S. announcement on satellite and broadcast services, Lang said: "This is a narrow surgical step."
Lang, who is U.S. Deputy Trade Representative, was speaking during a meeting of negotiators in Geneva to assess the state of play at the talks.
The negotiations on a global pact to liberalise the world's telecommunications trade face a Saturday deadline of midnight in Geneva (2300 GMT).
Major trading partners have been piling pressure on Washington to agree to what they say is a potentially powerful pact to open up the booming industry to worldwide competition.
